{{Quote|You think I can be bribed?''"<br />"''I think you can be reasonable. As a man of medicine.''"<br />"''Right. I'll be a few minutes|The doctor and Jarael|<ref name="NightsOfAngerPt1" />}}
An '''Arkanian''' '''doctor''' worked in a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Adascopolis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]. The doctor was given a [[Blood/Legends|blood]] sample by [[Jarael]], a disguised [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoot]]&mdash;a [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically-altered]] Arkanian sub-[[Species/Legends|species]] not allowed in the harshly-segregated city&mdash;and was instructed to analyze it. After suggesting a new product offered by [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania|Adascorp]], the doctor realized the blood was of an Offshoot and hesitated to comply with Jarael's request. Noting the hesitation, Jarael bribed the doctor and appealed to his status as a [[Gender/Legends|man]] of medicine. The doctor agreed and left for several [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to analyze the sample.<ref name="NightsOfAngerPt1" />

When analyzed, the blood sample revealed that the source of the blood was from a former Adascorp [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Gorman Vandrayk]]. Vandrayk, now known by the name Camper, was needed by [[Arkoh Adasca]], chief executive of the [[House of Adasca]] and Adascorp, for a future operation. Adasca ordered Adascopolis forces to detain Jarael, knowing that she would be the best possible link to finding Vandrayk. The doctor was also instructed to stall Jarael to allow [[Time/Legends|time]] for the Adascopolis forces to arrive. After the doctor failed to bluff his way into forcing Jarael to stay, the Arkanian Offshoot attempted to leave but was intercepted. To defend herself, Jarael took the doctor and threw him into the group of approaching guards.<ref name="NightsOfAngerPt1" />
